notes.title: "Hungry Meem" Exhibits at Tokyo Game Dungeon 9!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45432268/aae9470862d40dd616fa5ae06edbfff5c95ae9c1.png"][/img][/p][p]"Hungry Meem" will be exhibiting at Tokyo Game Dungeon 9, held on Sunday, August 3rd. We will have demo stations set up and will also be distributing novelties![/p][p][/p][h3][b]To celebrate our launch on Steam, we're holding a 20% OFF launch sale![/b] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3051240"][/dynamiclink]This is a completely new game conceived by Kenichi Nishi of "Chibi-Robo!" and "moon," with world design by Yukito Morikawa of "Pet in TV"[/h3][p][/p][p]It's a unique world with a new generation colony simulation combining "Breeding" and "Metroidvania" elements.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the features is an AI-driven game system, including a "character generation change system," where newly born "Meem" characters inherit the appearance and learned experiences of previous generations.[/p][p][/p][p]Embark on an adventure to World Tree to save the "Meem" on the brink of extinction![/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Exhibition Details[/b][/h3][p]Event Name: Tokyo Game Dungeon 9[/p][p]Exhibition Title: Hungry Meem[/p][p]Exhibition Booth: Tokyo Metropolitan Industrial Trade Center, Hamamatsucho Building, 3rd Floor, 3A-11[/p][p]Exhibition Period: Sunday, August 3, 2025, 12:00-17:00 JST[/p][p]Official Website: [url="https://tokyogamedungeon.com"]https://tokyogamedungeon.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p] We look forward to seeing you there! [/p]

notes.title: “Hungry Meem” released today on July 31!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45432268/5b918af40310f9dc094824685b6a84fff47bdcec.png"][/img][/p][p]Meems, the hungry creatures that live under the World Tree, are in danger of extinction! Let's make the Meems' lives happy by exploring around the World Tree with them and developing their settlement!

Original concept by Kenishi NIshi (“Chibi-Robo!” “moon”) and world design by Yukihito Morikawa (“Jumping Flash” “Pet in TV”), the new colony simulation game “Hungry Meem” allows players to experience of growing the World Tree and expanding the area through exploration while raising cute, hungry creatures called “Meems” and creating Meems with new skills through breeding, and the unique combination of “breeding” and “Metroidvania”. 

Celebrating the release, there will also be a sale going on! Don’t miss this chance to play this game! We will be also looking forward to your feedback! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3051240"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]Message from the Developer (Hitomi)[/b][/h3][p]Thank you for your patience! [/p][p]We are pleased to announce the release of the Steam version of “Hungry Mee” and is has been prepared to be played on your PC. The game is finally available for everyone who wishlisted from before, or just heard about this game now! [/p][p]Please enjoy the loveable world of Meems![/p][p]We will also be looking forward to your feedback on the game. “Hungry Meem" is a title that we have created with the aim of offering a high level of fresh experience and a wide range of extensibility. We hope that by receiving feedback and ideas not only from the developers, but also from players all over the world, we can infinitely expand this game![/p][p][/p][p]▼”Hungry Meem” Official X Account (Twitter)[/p][p][url="https://x.com/hungrymeem"]https://x.com/hungrymeem[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We will be announcing the latest info here! We also would like to hear your feedback!   [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3051240"][/dynamiclink]  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3374230"][/dynamiclink] [/p][p]▼”Hungry Meem” Official X Account (Twitter)[/p][p]JP: [url="https://x.com/hungrymeem_JP"]https://x.com/hungrymeem_JP[/url][/p][p]Global：[url="https://x.com/hungrymeem"]https://x.com/hungrymeem[/url][/p][p][/p][p]▼”Hungry Meem” Official Youtube Account[/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@hungrymeem"]https://www.youtube.com/@hungrymeem[/url][/p][p][/p][p]▼”Hungry Meem” Official Website[/p][p][url="https://hungrymeem.com "]https://hungrymeem.com [/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Notice of Release Date Change
notes.content: [p]We have an important announcement for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]We have decided to change the release date of the Steam version of "Hungry Meem" from June 19, 2025 (Thursday) JST to July 31, 2025 (Thursday) JST.[/p][p]While development of the game itself is progressing smoothly, there remain some challenges as we work on adjustments to ensure smooth gameplay on PC environments.[/p][p]For this reason, we have made the decision to postpone the release of the Steam version.[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to those who have been eagerly awaiting the Steam version's release.[/p][p][/p][p]Regarding the price, we will share further details later, but for now, we plan to set it at the same price as the product that will be released earlier.[/p][p]The entire team is striving to deliver the game in its best possible state as quickly as we can, and we would appreciate your patience in the meantime.[/p][p][/p][p]Drecom Co., Ltd.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 2nd Trailer Available! Live Streaming at the Store Page!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45432268/11af48e0b29d09367f173e6c778ef45cc7434688.png[/img]
The 2nd trailer for “Hungry Meem,” a new colony simulation game currently in development, was released today. This title participated in the world's largest indie game information program, INDIE Live Expo, which was broadcast on April 13, and the latest 2nd trailer was shown during the program. You can watch the broadcast including the 2nd trailer on the official archive of the event, so please take this opportunity to check it out

The 2nd trailer released depicts the background of the story and the game cycle of exploration and base building, and features a beautiful and unique worldview expressed through the unique illustrations by Yukihito Morikawa. Scenes showing the adorable lives of the Meems and the in-depth story narrated by the narrator also add color to the video.

[h3][b][url=https://youtu.be/Ci-muwu_3Tc]2nd Trailer[/url][/b][/h3]

In addition, Steam is offering a special sale to coincide with the Indie Live Expo. In addition, within the Steam store page for “Hungry Meems,” we are offering a live streaming video of the game up to the beginning of World Tree Lv. 2. Please take this opportunity to learn more about this title and enjoy the latest video being released.

Additionally, save data from the DEMO version is expected to be incompatible with the official release.

notes.title: “Hungry Meem” released worldwide simultaneously on June 19!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45432268/8061a3a1d66bacd6204d3afe65e72e463e66f40c.jpg[/img]
This game features a unique game system in which players train AI characters “Meems” and breed over generations to explore dungeons. This attractive game experience is created by Kenichi Nishi's (“Chibi-Robo!” “moon”) original concept and Yulihito Morikawa's (“Jumping Flash!” “Pet in TV”) world design art.

[b][h3]■Comments from Yukihito Morikawa (World Design Art)[/h3][/b]
Welcome to the mysterious world of Meems! 
Please take good care of these clumsy, curious-filled, little selfish creatures that gradually become smarter. Also enjoy exploring the mysterious world based on ruins of a mysterious civilization!

[b][h3]■Development Team[/h3][/b]
[b]・Original Story/Production: Drecom Co., Ltd./ E-One Inc.
・Worldview Design: Yukihito Morikawa[/b]

Notable titles include "Pet in TV", "Jumping Flash!", "Astronōka", "Kumauta", and "Neko ga Kita". For all games, he was in charge of game direction, game design, specification design, character design, and AI design.

notes.title: ”Hungry Meem” Exhibiting at GDC 2025!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45432268/c07a6dc0716ac90ec9412c990e1933d648d3ab6f.png[/img]
“Hungry Meem”, a new colony simulation game currently in development, will be exhibited at the GDC Expo Japan Pavilion. At the exhibition booth, there will be a playable demo where visitors can actually play the game. One of the features of this title is a game system that uses AI, such as the character generation system that randomly generates new characters that inherit the appearance, learned experience, and other characteristics of the Meems developed in the game through cross-generation. You can experience the new gaming system that uses AI technology at GDC.

[h3][b]■ Event Info[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Title: Hungry Meem
[*] Booth: Moscone Center Expo Hall C1669 Japan Pavilion Booth 
[*] Event Period: March 19, 2025 (10:00) - March 21, 2025 (15:00) (Local Time)
